transforms.code:
# ---- Master/AssemblyDetail combined grid builder — inline runPrepQuery (Order-spike pattern) ----
	# Executes the canonical AssemblyDetail/list SQL from master-crud-namedqueries.sql.
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain parameterized T-SQL; runs identically on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	parts = unicode(value).split("|")
	searchTerm = parts[0]
	siteId = int(float(parts[1]))   # IG-SITE: plumbed view->query; predicate commented (D1)

	sql = ("SELECT  ID_FORECAST_DETAIL        AS RecordID, "
	       "        VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE  AS AssyCode, "
	       "        VC_EFFECTIVE_MONTH        AS EffMonth, "
	       "        VC_BROADCAST_CODE         AS Broadcast, "
	       "        VC_TIRE_PART_NUMBER_CODE  AS TirePN, "
	       "        VC_WHEEL_PART_NUMBER_CODE AS WheelPN, "
	       "        IN_TIRE_RATIO             AS TireRatio, "
	       "        IN_WHEEL_RATIO            AS WheelRatio, "
	       "        IN_RATIO                  AS FcRatio, "
	       "        IN_ASSY_QTY               AS AssyQty "
	       "FROM    INV_FORECAST_DETAIL_INF "
	       "WHERE  (? = '' OR VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE LIKE '%' + ? + '%' OR VC_BROADCAST_CODE LIKE '%' + ? + '%') "
	       "-- IG-SITE:  AND site_id = ? "
	       "ORDER BY VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(sql, [searchTerm, searchTerm, searchTerm], DB)
	log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail/list: %d rows (search='%s' site=%d)" % (ds.rowCount, searchTerm, siteId))

	columns = [
		{"field": "AssyCode",   "header": {"title": "Assy Part #"}, "strictWidth": 130, "sort": "ascending"},
		{"field": "EffMonth",   "header": {"title": "Eff Month"}, "strictWidth": 90},
		{"field": "Broadcast",  "header": {"title": "Broadcast"}, "strictWidth": 110},
		{"field": "TirePN",     "header": {"title": "Tire PN"}},
		{"field": "WheelPN",    "header": {"title": "Wheel PN"}},
		{"field": "TireRatio",  "header": {"title": "TireR"}, "strictWidth": 70},
		{"field": "WheelRatio", "header": {"title": "WhlR"}, "strictWidth": 70},
		{"field": "FcRatio",    "header": {"title": "FcR"}, "strictWidth": 60},
		{"field": "AssyQty",    "header": {"title": "Qty"}, "strictWidth": 60},
		{"field": "RecordID",   "header": {"title": "id"}, "visible": False}
	]
	rows = []
	for r in xrange(ds.rowCount):
		rows.append({
			"RecordID":   ds.getValueAt(r, "RecordID"),
			"AssyCode":   ds.getValueAt(r, "AssyCode"),
			"EffMonth":   ds.getValueAt(r, "EffMonth"),
			"Broadcast":  ds.getValueAt(r, "Broadcast"),
			"TirePN":     ds.getValueAt(r, "TirePN"),
			"WheelPN":    ds.getValueAt(r, "WheelPN"),
			"TireRatio":  ds.getValueAt(r, "TireRatio"),
			"WheelRatio": ds.getValueAt(r, "WheelRatio"),
			"FcRatio":    ds.getValueAt(r, "FcRatio"),
			"AssyQty":    ds.getValueAt(r, "AssyQty")
		})
	return {"data": rows, "columns": columns}

# ---- AssemblyDetail: part-number combo option source (lookups/partNumber) ----
	# NUMBER-STRING combos (NOT surrogate-FK): value == label == VC_PART_NUMBER string.
	# All 7 component combos (tire/wheel/valve/film/label/misc1/misc2) share this one
	# option list. Stores the string, never an id (legacy number-keyed design).
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain runPrepQuery; identical on 8.1.52 and 8.3.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	sql = ("SELECT DISTINCT VC_PART_NUMBER AS id, VC_PART_NUMBER AS label "
	       "FROM INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST WHERE VC_PART_NUMBER <> '' "
	       "-- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ? "
	       "ORDER BY VC_PART_NUMBER")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(sql, [], DB)
	opts = [{"value": "", "label": ""}]
	for r in xrange(ds.rowCount):
		pn = ds.getValueAt(r, "id")
		opts.append({"value": pn, "label": pn})
	log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail/partNumber lookup: %d part numbers" % ds.rowCount)
	return opts

onChange.script:
# ---- AssemblyDetail combined view: recordId change -> load detail ----
	# Grid onRowClick sets self.view.custom.recordId = row["RecordID"] (same-view prop
	# write, NO navigation). This onChange fires and populates the in-view form.
	# recordId==0 -> insert mode. D2: RecordID is ID_FORECAST_DETAIL, never the code.
	# IG81-COMPAT: plain change script + T-SQL.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	v = self.view if hasattr(self, "view") else self
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = v.custom
	cv = getattr(currentValue, "value", currentValue)
	recId = int(cv or 0)
	log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail Detail recordId onChange fired: recId=%s origin=%s" % (recId, origin))

	if recId <= 0:
		c.statusMsg = "New assembly detail — enter details and Save."
		log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail Detail: insert mode (recordId=0)")
		return

	getSql = ("SELECT ID_FORECAST_DETAIL, VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE, VC_EFFECTIVE_MONTH, "
	          "VC_BROADCAST_CODE, VC_ASSY_KANBAN_NUMBER, "
	          "VC_TIRE_PART_NUMBER_CODE, VC_WHEEL_PART_NUMBER_CODE, "
	          "VC_VALVE_PART_NUMBER, VC_FILM_PART_NUMBER, "
	          "VC_LABEL_PART_NUMBER, VC_MISC1_PART_NUMBER, VC_MISC2_PART_NUMBER, "
	          "IN_TIRE_RATIO, IN_WHEEL_RATIO, IN_RATIO, IN_ASSY_QTY "
	          "FROM INV_FORECAST_DETAIL_INF WHERE ID_FORECAST_DETAIL = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
	ds = system.db.runPrepQuery(getSql, [recId], DB)
	if ds.rowCount == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Assembly detail id %d not found." % recId
		log.warn("SPIKE AssemblyDetail Detail: id %d not found" % recId); return
	def gs(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return val if val is not None else ""
	def gi(col):
		val = ds.getValueAt(0, col)
		return int(val) if val is not None else 0
	c.form_assyCode  = gs("VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE")
	c.form_effMonth  = gs("VC_EFFECTIVE_MONTH")
	c.form_broadcast = gs("VC_BROADCAST_CODE")
	c.form_kanban    = gs("VC_ASSY_KANBAN_NUMBER")
	c.form_tirePN    = gs("VC_TIRE_PART_NUMBER_CODE")
	c.form_wheelPN   = gs("VC_WHEEL_PART_NUMBER_CODE")
	c.form_valvePN   = gs("VC_VALVE_PART_NUMBER")
	c.form_filmPN    = gs("VC_FILM_PART_NUMBER")
	c.form_labelPN   = gs("VC_LABEL_PART_NUMBER")
	c.form_misc1PN   = gs("VC_MISC1_PART_NUMBER")
	c.form_misc2PN   = gs("VC_MISC2_PART_NUMBER")
	c.form_tireRatio  = gi("IN_TIRE_RATIO")
	c.form_wheelRatio = gi("IN_WHEEL_RATIO")
	c.form_fcRatio    = gi("IN_RATIO")
	c.form_assyQty    = gi("IN_ASSY_QTY")
	c.statusMsg = "Editing assembly %s (id %d)." % (c.form_assyCode, recId)
	log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail Detail loaded id=%d assy=%s eff='%s' tire=%s wheel=%s fcR=%s" % (recId, c.form_assyCode, c.form_effMonth, c.form_tirePN, c.form_wheelPN, c.form_fcRatio))

config.script:
# Re-run AssemblyDetail/list by bumping runNonce.
	self.view.custom.runNonce = (self.view.custom.runNonce or 0) + 1
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("AssemblyDetail search -> runNonce=" + str(self.view.custom.runNonce))

# New record: same-view prop write (NO navigation). recordId=0 -> insert-mode.
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE AssemblyDetail New DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	c.form_assyCode = ""; c.form_effMonth = ""; c.form_broadcast = ""; c.form_kanban = ""
	c.form_tirePN = ""; c.form_wheelPN = ""; c.form_valvePN = ""; c.form_filmPN = ""
	c.form_labelPN = ""; c.form_misc1PN = ""; c.form_misc2PN = ""
	c.form_tireRatio = 0; c.form_wheelRatio = 0; c.form_fcRatio = 0; c.form_assyQty = 0
	c.recordId = 0
	c.statusMsg = "New assembly detail — enter details and Save."
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail New -> recordId=0 (insert mode)")

# Row select -> SAME-VIEW prop write (single-view; NO navigation).
	# event.value is the row data in IA 8.1. Set custom.recordId, which fires the
	# custom.recordId onChange load script. D2: RecordID is ID_FORECAST_DETAIL.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	try:
		recId = event.value["RecordID"]
	except Exception:
		recId = event.value["RecordID"] if hasattr(event, "value") else None
	if recId is None:
		log.warn("SPIKE AssemblyDetail list row click: no RecordID in event")
		return
	log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail list -> open Detail recordId=%s" % recId)
	self.view.custom.recordId = int(recId)

props.text: Click a row to edit at right. Component part #s are stored as STRINGS (not FK ids) — combos source distinct VC_PART_NUMBER from INV_PARTS_STOCK_MST. Composite identity = (assy code, effective month). Single combined view; row-select is an in-view prop write, no navigation.

config.script:
# ---- AssemblyDetail Save (insert-or-update) ----
	# recordId==0 -> insert; >0 -> update. Composite uniqueness pre-check on
	# (assy code, effective month) — there is NO unique index on the live table, so
	# this app pre-check is the ONLY uniqueness enforcement.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE AssemblyDetail Save DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	siteId = int(c.siteId or 1)   # IG-SITE: plumbed; predicate commented (D1)

	assy = (c.form_assyCode or "").strip()
	eff  = (c.form_effMonth or "").strip()

	# ---- validation (presence on assy code + composite-dup; ratios optional) ----
	if assy == "":
		c.statusMsg = "Assembly part number is required."
		log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail save REJECTED: blank assy code"); return
	if len(assy) > 12:
		c.statusMsg = "Assembly part number must be 12 characters or fewer."
		log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail save REJECTED: assy len=%d" % len(assy)); return

	def sv(x):
		return (x or "").strip()
	def toInt(v):
		try:
			return int(v) if v not in (None, "") else 0
		except Exception:
			return 0

	excludeId = recId if recId > 0 else 0
	# COMPOSITE dup-check: (assy code, effective month). NOT single-code.
	chkSql = ("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM INV_FORECAST_DETAIL_INF "
	          "WHERE VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE = ? AND VC_EFFECTIVE_MONTH = ? "
	          "AND ID_FORECAST_DETAIL <> ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
	dup = system.db.runPrepQuery(chkSql, [assy, eff, excludeId], DB)
	if dup.rowCount > 0 and int(dup.getValueAt(0, 0)) > 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Assembly + effective month already exists (%s / '%s')." % (assy, eff)
		log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail save REJECTED: dup composite assy=%s eff='%s'" % (assy, eff)); return

	audit = ("CONVERT(char(8),GETDATE(),112) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),1,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),4,2) "
	         "+ SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),7,2) + SUBSTRING(CONVERT(varchar,GETDATE(),114),10,2)")

	data = [assy, eff, sv(c.form_broadcast), sv(c.form_kanban),
	        sv(c.form_tirePN), sv(c.form_wheelPN), sv(c.form_valvePN), sv(c.form_filmPN),
	        sv(c.form_labelPN), sv(c.form_misc1PN), sv(c.form_misc2PN),
	        toInt(c.form_tireRatio), toInt(c.form_wheelRatio), toInt(c.form_fcRatio), toInt(c.form_assyQty)]

	try:
		if recId == 0:
			insSql = ("INSERT INTO INV_FORECAST_DETAIL_INF "
			          "(VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE, VC_EFFECTIVE_MONTH, VC_BROADCAST_CODE, VC_ASSY_KANBAN_NUMBER, "
			          " VC_TIRE_PART_NUMBER_CODE, VC_WHEEL_PART_NUMBER_CODE, VC_VALVE_PART_NUMBER, VC_FILM_PART_NUMBER, "
			          " VC_LABEL_PART_NUMBER, VC_MISC1_PART_NUMBER, VC_MISC2_PART_NUMBER, "
			          " IN_TIRE_RATIO, IN_WHEEL_RATIO, IN_RATIO, IN_ASSY_QTY, VC_ADD) "
			          "VALUES (?,?,?,?, ?,?,?,?, ?,?,?, ?,?,?,?, " + audit + "); "
			          "SELECT CAST(SCOPE_IDENTITY() AS int) AS newId")
			rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(insSql, data, DB)
			newId = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
			c.statusMsg = "Inserted assembly %s (id %d)." % (assy, newId)
			log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail INSERT ok: assy=%s eff='%s' newId=%d" % (assy, eff, newId))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1
			c.recordId = newId
		else:
			updSql = ("UPDATE INV_FORECAST_DETAIL_INF SET "
			          "VC_ASSY_PART_NUMBER_CODE=?, VC_EFFECTIVE_MONTH=?, VC_BROADCAST_CODE=?, VC_ASSY_KANBAN_NUMBER=?, "
			          "VC_TIRE_PART_NUMBER_CODE=?, VC_WHEEL_PART_NUMBER_CODE=?, VC_VALVE_PART_NUMBER=?, VC_FILM_PART_NUMBER=?, "
			          "VC_LABEL_PART_NUMBER=?, VC_MISC1_PART_NUMBER=?, VC_MISC2_PART_NUMBER=?, "
			          "IN_TIRE_RATIO=?, IN_WHEEL_RATIO=?, IN_RATIO=?, IN_ASSY_QTY=?, "
			          "VC_LAST_UPDATE = " + audit + " "
			          "WHERE ID_FORECAST_DETAIL = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?")
			n = system.db.runPrepUpdate(updSql, data + [recId], DB)
			c.statusMsg = "Updated assembly %s (%d row)." % (assy, n)
			log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail UPDATE ok: id=%d assy=%s rows=%d" % (recId, assy, n))
			c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1
	except Exception, e:
		c.statusMsg = "Save failed: %s" % unicode(e)
		log.warn("SPIKE AssemblyDetail save FAILED: %s" % unicode(e))

# ---- AssemblyDetail Delete — D3 RESTRICT gate (R1-critical) ----
	# The live DeleteForecastDetail trigger HARD-DELETEs INV_FORECAST_INF rows whose
	# VC_PART_NUMBER = this row's assy code. refCount counts those rows and BLOCKS the
	# delete if > 0, so the destructive cascade can never fire silently. P12 forbids
	# touching the live trigger; the gate is the only lever and mirrors the trigger body.
	log = system.util.getLogger("SPIKE")
	DB = "Inventory_Spike"
	c = self.view.custom
	# ---- SERVER-SIDE WRITE GATE (M4 P15 sweep — the H3 hole-closer) ----
	# auth.requireWrite resolves the caller's roles FROM THE SESSION (gateway-side, NOT a client
	# prop) and authorizes ProductionControl|Admin, raising AuthError on deny — BEFORE any
	# system.db write. A forged client prop or an anonymous session is rejected HERE, not by the
	# UI. This closes the reintroduced legacy H3 hole (the write was previously authorized client-
	# side only). Same gate the Sites Save/Delete/New carry (gen_sites_view.py rule #1).
	import auth as A
	try:
		A.requireWrite(self.session)
	except A.AuthError, e:
		c.statusMsg = "DENIED (server-side): " + unicode(e)
		system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").warn("SPIKE AssemblyDetail Delete DENIED (server-side gate): " + unicode(e)); return
	recId = int(c.recordId or 0)
	assy = (c.form_assyCode or "").strip()
	if recId == 0:
		c.statusMsg = "Nothing to delete (unsaved new record)."
		return
	refSql = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM INV_FORECAST_INF WHERE VC_PART_NUMBER = ?"
	rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(refSql, [assy], DB)
	n = int(rs.getValueAt(0, 0))
	log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail refCount: id=%d assy=%s n=%d" % (recId, assy, n))
	if n > 0:
		c.statusMsg = ("Cannot delete assembly %s — still referenced by %d forecast row(s). "
		               "Deleting would cascade-delete those forecasts. Remove or archive them first.") % (assy, n)
		log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail DELETE BLOCKED: id=%d assy=%s refs=%d" % (recId, assy, n)); return
	try:
		delN = system.db.runPrepUpdate("DELETE FROM INV_FORECAST_DETAIL_INF WHERE ID_FORECAST_DETAIL = ? -- IG-SITE: AND site_id = ?", [recId], DB)
		log.info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail DELETE ok: id=%d assy=%s rows=%d" % (recId, assy, delN))
		c.statusMsg = "Deleted assembly %s." % assy
		c.form_assyCode = ""; c.form_effMonth = ""; c.form_broadcast = ""; c.form_kanban = ""
		c.form_tirePN = ""; c.form_wheelPN = ""; c.form_valvePN = ""; c.form_filmPN = ""
		c.form_labelPN = ""; c.form_misc1PN = ""; c.form_misc2PN = ""
		c.form_tireRatio = 0; c.form_wheelRatio = 0; c.form_fcRatio = 0; c.form_assyQty = 0
		c.runNonce = (c.runNonce or 0) + 1
		c.recordId = 0
	except Exception, e:
		c.statusMsg = "Delete failed: %s" % unicode(e)
		log.warn("SPIKE AssemblyDetail DELETE FAILED: %s" % unicode(e))

# Clear -> reset to a blank insert-mode form (recordId=0). Same-view, no navigation.
	c = self.view.custom
	c.form_assyCode = ""; c.form_effMonth = ""; c.form_broadcast = ""; c.form_kanban = ""
	c.form_tirePN = ""; c.form_wheelPN = ""; c.form_valvePN = ""; c.form_filmPN = ""
	c.form_labelPN = ""; c.form_misc1PN = ""; c.form_misc2PN = ""
	c.form_tireRatio = 0; c.form_wheelRatio = 0; c.form_fcRatio = 0; c.form_assyQty = 0
	c.recordId = 0
	c.statusMsg = "Cleared — ready for a new assembly detail."
	system.util.getLogger("SPIKE").info("SPIKE AssemblyDetail form cleared")
